items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I first saw Slim Waters. His name was Slim Waters.

ctx.x: On tuba, yes. And I think he would have been naturally part of my inspiration, too. Although I thought of the tuba principally at that time as a rhythm instrument, and only later did I begin to get into the melodic thing. That's not quite true, because I do remember when I was in school picking out melodies. "Stardust" was one. And I used to out on the campus by myself and play these things. This was before I even heard Slim Waters, who was phenomenal. He later became the President or something of a local in…
Did he play melodically on the tuba?
